[[Cyndr's Heart]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[focus item]] obtained from the [[Mountain Heart Chest]], which appears after killing [[Cyndr the Mountain Heart]]  or [[Magmus]] in the [[Heart of the Shiverpeaks]]. 

==Stats==
:[[Energy]] +12 (Requires 9 [[Fire Magic]])
:[[Energy]] +15
:[[Energy regeneration]] -1
:[[Health]] +30

==Skin==
This item uses the same [[skin]] as the [[Fire Prism]].

==Replica==
Except for the visual appearance, an exact technical replica for this item is the [[Flame Artifact]] from collector [[Jung Zeng]] or crafter [[Honglei Sun]].


Except for the visual appearance, it is possible to create an exact technical replica for this item with:
*One of the following [[Fire Magic]] [[focus item]]s:
**[[Flame Artifact]] from collector [[Danira]]
**[[Destroyer Focus]] from crafter [[Balthor Coalforge]]
**[[Imperial Focus]] from collector [[Shen Xi]]
**[[Tormented Focus]] from collector [[Deacon of Whispers]]
*[[Perfect]] "[[Inscription|Live for Today]]" inscription
OR
*One of the following [[Fire Magic]] [[focus item]]s:
**[[Flame Artifact]] from crafters [[Asa]], [[Derrick]], [[Hadusi]], [[Shausha]], [[Soros]], or [[Tehshan]]
**[[Asuran Focus]] from crafter [[Nojj]]
**[[Balthazar's Focus]] from collector [[Zaishen Elemental Weapon Master]]
**[[Deldrimor Focus]] from crafter [[Grand Mason Stonecleaver]]
**[[Focus of Purity]] from collector [[Iza Yoi]]
**[[Norn Focus]] from crafter [[Keti]]
**[[Oppressor's Focus]] from collector [[Lionguard (collector)|Lionguard]]
**[[Charr Focus]] from collector [[Tuomas]] (requires [[Bonus Mission Pack]])
**[[Mursaat Focus]] from collector [[Diane]] (requires Bonus Mission Pack)
**[[Tengu Focus]] from collector [[Akemi]] (requires Bonus Mission Pack)
**[[Undead Focus]] from collector [[Archivist of Whispers]] (requires Bonus Mission Pack)
*[[Perfect]] [[Focus Core]] [[of Fortitude]]
*[[Perfect]] "[[Inscription|Live for Today]]" inscription

==Unique counterparts==
[[Snapjaw's Powerstone]] and [[Tarlok's Flagon]] have stats nearly identical to this item; however, they require [[Energy Storage]].
